title: Intelligent Textbook Ecosystem Dynamics
description: A causal loop diagram showing how AI capabilities, MicroSims, faceted search, and teacher adoption interact to transform educational publishing.
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Distinguish the three reinforcing loops (R1 adoption flywheel, R2 AI content virtuous cycle, R3 cost collapse) from the B1 publisher-resistance balancing loop
Trace the R1 causal chain from teacher adoption to student outcomes to demand and back to teacher awareness
Explain why faceted search engines act as a high-leverage point that accelerates the entire adoption cycle
Analyze how demand for intelligent textbooks threatens publisher revenue and feeds back as reluctance to invest in AI tools
Predict how the ecosystem behaves if AI capabilities plateau rather than continuing to double every 7 months
